why: Grant's alma mater. Division II Peach Belt, no football team, so it is in none of ESPN's lists. Background is the school navy: build_team_library re-scored it against the new artwork on 2026-09-10 and still chose primary, and green loses 38% of the mark's ink into the field against navy's 6%. The `source` URL is kept for provenance but is no longer what gets built: that file carries a GCSU wordmark overlapping the bobcat's jaw, so no crop_bottom keeps the whole animal and drops the lettering, and the version shipped until 2026-09-10 had its chin cut off.
source_file_note: Supplied by Grant on 2026-09-10 as a 1254px render of the Georgia College Bobcats primary mark on a flat royal-blue field. Not the school's own file and not the Wikipedia one: it is the wordmark-free cut with a white keyline, which is what makes it usable here. Keyed and shaped by fetch_extra_teams.py.
